subject.title: fix(qqbot): limit channel API targets to configured groups [AI]

question: Should `qqbot_channel_api` fail closed for all raw guild/channel paths whenever QQBot group scope is narrowed, unless wildcard or unscoped policy is configured?
rationale: The code path is a QQBot-specific authenticated API proxy; automation can verify the implementation shape, but maintainers need to choose the permanent compatibility and security behavior for scoped operators.

options.title: Approve fail-closed scoped raw API
options.body: Keep this PR's behavior and merge after QQBot owner approval because narrowed group configs intentionally disable broad raw guild/channel paths.

options.title: Require target-scope design
options.body: Pause this PR and require a dedicated guild/channel target allowlist with docs and compatibility tests if scoped raw API access should remain possible.

options.title: Decline this boundary change
options.body: Leave raw channel API behavior unchanged and track any broader QQBot API security design separately.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed scoped raw API
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's behavior and merge after QQBot owner approval because narrowed group configs intentionally disable broad raw guild/channel paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is QQBot-specific and sliverp owns the original QQBot channel feature history.
